column1: # Air combat redesign (2026-10-20): aircraft, anti-air vehicles and runway airfield.
Aircraft service: 4 jet stands, 2 helipads · rearm and repair
column2: 航空维修：4 个喷气机停机位、2 个直升机坪 · 补给弹药并维修

column1: Runway airfield. Builds drones, helicopters, fighters and bombers; jets park, rearm and repair on 4 stands, rotorcraft on 2 helipads. Uses 8 power.
column2: 跑道机场。生产无人机、直升机、战斗机与轰炸机；喷气机在 4 个停机位停放、补给与维修，旋翼机使用 2 个直升机坪。消耗 8 电力。

column1: Shoulder-launched rockets break heavy armor and structures; guided missiles lock onto aircraft. Slow reload, weak against infantry.
column2: 肩射火箭克制重装甲与建筑，制导导弹可锁定飞机；装填较慢，不擅长对付步兵。

column1: Air superiority jet. Guided missiles and cannon hit aircraft only; lands at its airfield to rearm.
column2: 制空喷气战机。制导导弹与机炮只打击空中目标；返回机场降落补给弹药。

column1: Heavy level bomber. One stick of bombs per sortie against ground forces and structures; needs fighter escort.
column2: 重型水平轰炸机。每次出击向地面部队与建筑投下一串炸弹；需要战斗机护航。

column1: No free stand · every jet parks and rearms on its own stand.
column2: 没有空闲停机位 · 每架喷气机都需在自己的停机位停放与补给。

column1: Free an aircraft stand to resume this queue.
column2: 腾出一个停机位以继续此生产队列。

column1: Expendable loitering munition. Scouts while hovering; an attack order sends it diving into a vehicle or structure as its own warhead. Holds fire by default.
column2: 一次性巡飞弹。悬停时可侦察；下达攻击命令后会以自身为弹头俯冲撞向车辆或建筑。默认不开火。

column1: Attack helicopter. Rockets against ground forces while hovering in place; lands on an airfield helipad to rearm. Vulnerable to rocket infantry and anti-air.
column2: 武装直升机。悬停原地用火箭打击地面部队；降落在机场直升机坪补给弹药。易被火箭步兵与防空火力击落。

column1: Mobile air defense on a tank chassis. Engages aircraft only; escort it with tanks and infantry against ground attack.
column2: 坦克底盘的机动防空单位。只攻击空中目标；需要坦克与步兵护卫以防地面进攻。
